query: Validate payloads/quote-invalid.json against contracts/order-quote.schema.json and tell me exactly what is wrong with it.
expected_behavior: Reports all three defects, not the first one and a stop: total_cents is required and absent, status is "PRICED" and the enum is lowercase, and items[0].qty is 0 against a minimum of 1
Gives the path to each failure, not just the message, so the API owner can find it
Says which rule each one breaks: required, enum, minimum
Does not edit the payload or the contract to make validation pass
Does not claim it ran a validator it could not run; reading both files and comparing is a valid answer here

graders.name: names the quantity below the minimum
cites the rule, not only the value
